{{Short description|German mathematician (born 1961)}}
{{BLP sources|date=January 2013}}
'''Lothar Göttsche''' (born January 21, 1961, in [[Sønderborg Municipality|Sonderburg]], [[Denmark]]) is a German mathematician, known for his work in [[algebraic geometry]].

He is a research scientist at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] in [[Trieste]], Italy. He is also editor for [[Geometry & Topology]].

== Biography ==
After studying mathematics at the [[University of Kiel]], he received his [[Dr. rer. nat.]] under the direction of [[Friedrich Hirzebruch]] at the [[University of Bonn]] in 1989.

Göttsche was invited as speaker to the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Beijing in 2002.<ref>{{cite book|author=Göttsche, Lothar|chapter=Hilbert schemes of points on surfaces (arXiv preprint math/0304302 (2003))|title=Proceedings of the ICM, Beijing 2002|year=2003|volume=2|pages=483–494|arxiv=math/0304302|bibcode=2003math......4302G}}</ref> 
In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-01-19.</ref>

== Work ==
Göttsche received international acclaim with his formula for the [[generating function]] for the [[Betti numbers]] of the [[Hilbert scheme]] of points on an algebraic [[Surface (topology)|surface]]:

:If <math>S</math> is a smooth surface over an algebraically closed field of characteristic <math>0</math>, then the generating function for the motives of the Hilbert schemes of <math>S</math> can be expressed in terms of the [[motivic zeta function]] by Göttsche's formula
::<math>\sum_{n=0}^\infty[S^{[n]}]t^n=\prod_{m=1}^\infty Z(S,{\mathbb L}^{m-1}t^m)</math>
:Here <math>S^{[n]}</math> is the Hilbert scheme of length <math>n</math> subschemes of <math>S</math>.

Göttsche is also the author of a celebrated conjecture predicting the number of [[curve]]s in certain [[Linear system of divisors|linear systems]] on algebraic [[Algebraic surfaces|surfaces]].<ref>{{cite journal|author=Göttsche, L.|year=1998|title=A conjectural generating function for numbers of curves on surfaces|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics|volume=196|issue=3|pages=523–533|doi=10.1007/s002200050434|bibcode=1998CMaPh.196..523G|arxiv=alg-geom/9711012|s2cid=9283407}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|author=Kool, M.|author2=Shende, V.|author3=Thomas, R. P.|authorlink3=Richard Thomas (mathematician)|title=A short proof of the Göttsche conjecture|journal=Geometry & Topology|volume=15|pages=397–406|year=2014|arxiv=1010.3211|doi=10.2140/gt.2011.15.397|s2cid=55830264}}</ref>
